##### Project general facts

The Astera by Aston Martin is an iconic residential tower developed by DarGlobal in collaboration with the legendary British automotive brand Aston Martin. This exclusive development represents the seamless fusion of bespoke style, cutting-edge material science, and unparalleled craftsmanship. Each residence is masterfully designed to emulate the dynamic flow of a power wave, ensuring breathtaking views from every angle, while reflecting over a century of British ingenuity and the spirit of authentic island living.

Residents are treated to a range of world-class amenities at the podium level, including direct beach access, an infinity pool offering breathtaking ocean views, a scenic walk track, lush green spaces, an indoor cinema, a fitness centre, a spa, a multipurpose hall, a kids' play area, a yoga lawn, and a pool bar. Every corner of the development invites relaxation and rejuvenation, with sweeping vistas of the Arabian Gulf, the city's iconic skyline, and the bustling island.

Inspired by the sleek lines and dynamic forms of Aston Martin, the interiors feature a plethora of rich materials such as fine leather, polished metals, and exotic woods, seamlessly integrated to exude performance and bespoke style. Each meticulous detail elevates the living experience, ensuring optimal performance and comfort. The Astera offers a bespoke lifestyle experience that embodies the essence of luxury living, with every detail reflecting a commitment to excellence and sophistication.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled along the pristine shores of Al Marjan Island, this exceptional location offers one of four exquisite man-made coral-shaped islands that extend into the azure waters of the Arabian Gulf. Just a short drive away from the vibrant city of Dubai, residents can enjoy an elevated lifestyle that seamlessly blends seclusion and convenience, with direct beach access within the rapidly expanding greater downtown area of Ras Al Khaimah.

The location is distinguished by its lush landscapes, diverse marine life, and unparalleled experiences that cater to every desire. Residents can bask on pristine beaches, enjoy world-class resorts, luxury hotels, retail outlets, and a wide range of recreational activities. The bustling neighborhoods of the island, luxury resorts, and attractions brim with an array of amenities to explore and indulge in, while breathtaking sunsets and vibrant nightlife enhance the coastal living experience.

For those seeking a residence that embodies exceptional engineering, coastal elegance, and a prime Ras Al Khaimah address, Al Marjan Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of the region's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can experience the fiercely independent island spirit.
